text:
Maya (PM): quick sync — we need final cuts for the upcoming ship window. traffic triggers pushed us into a hard cap. proposing: 1) ship MVP w/ core chat + embeddings read-only 2) defer tenant SSO to v1 3) move emb-cache to optional addon 4) keep dedicated routing but reduce initial capacity. thoughts?

Liam (Eng): i can sign up to that if we carve out a clear rollback path for routing. capacity reduction = less infra work. :+1:

Sophia (Product Ops): agree on deferring tenant SSO. we have 2 enterprise pilots that want it badly though — can we offer a short-term manual integration?

Maya (PM): short-term manual integration seems reasonable for pilots, documented runbook and expectation that it's unsupported during GA. anyone opposed?

Raj (Infra): manual integration ok. on emb-cache: making it addon complicates routing decisions — we should flag any perf regressive cases in the console. I'll add a dashboard alert.

Anya (Design): we should keep the lowest-effort UX path for onboarding when SSO is deferred. a single sign-on CTA that explains "available in v1" + email invite flow. simple copy change.

Liam (Eng): technical trade: if we ship MVP without emb-cache, P99 jumps ~30% on long-history chats. can we do partial cache (prefix-only) as a compromise? cheaper dev work than full cache.

Maya (PM): proposal: partial prefix cache in MVP (best-effort), full emb-cache as addon for early adopters, tenant SSO held for v1. commit?

Sophia (Product Ops): +1, but we need clear launch criteria: latency under 300ms median, error rate <0.5%, and canary at 5% for first 48h.

Maya (PM): adding that to acceptance. also recommend a timeline reset: shift GA by 2 weeks to finish prefix-cache + run canary. this is the only place we accept a small slip.

Liam (Eng): 2 weeks seems doable if we deprioritize nonblocking analytics features. I'll post a short diff of sprint scope.

Raj (Infra): canary policy acked. I'll configure fallback routing to the smaller model if latency crosses threshold. need an owner for the rollback script.

Maya (PM): Liam to own rollback script, Raj to own fallback routing, Sophia to coordinate comms for pilots. Anya to update onboarding copy. I'll update roadmap and notify stakeholders.

Liam (Eng): creating a PR for the rollback script now. snippet: ```sh
# quick rollback
./deploy rollback --to=previous
```

release-bot: Deploy window scheduled: 2026-05-08 22:00 UTC — canary target 5% for 48h.

Sophia (Product Ops): noted. I'll draft the pilot comms and a short FAQ for manual SSO instructions.

Anya (Design): will put together a tiny modal + copy for "SSO in v1" and email invite flow by EOD tomorrow.

Maya (PM): thanks all. final decision: cut full tenant SSO from MVP, make emb-cache addon + implement prefix-cache compromise, reduce dedicated routing capacity, shift GA by 2 weeks to finish prefix-cache + run canary. if anyone has objections, raise by EOD today. otherwise I'll lock the cutlist. :lock:

Liam (Eng): no objections from eng.

Raj (Infra): no objections from infra.

Sophia (Product Ops): no objections from ops.

Anya (Design): no objections from design.

Maya (PM): locking in 2-week shift and cutlist. I'll ping execs after I update the roadmap doc.
